section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the Romanian context for examining the BAS-2 translation and psychometric properties. It emphasizes the importance of providing body image assessment tools for Romanian and Moldovan speakers (approximately 24 million first-language speakers) and discusses unique cultural and historical factors in Romania, including the potential impact of post-Communist market economy adoption on body image disturbances. The section notes that while a previous Romanian BAS translation exists (Dumitrescu et al., 2008), it lacked proper translational documentation and did not examine the factor structure, assuming one-dimensionality without empirical support.
